facts.fact: MISA Zimbabwe's chairperson says Zimbabweans are increasingly using the Freedom of Information Act to claim their right to information.

MISA Zimbabwe's chairperson says the Zimbabwe Media Commission has issued release orders to public institutions that must provide the information requested under the Freedom of Information Act; no number or date of orders is given.

ZWE.note: Only says a national AI policy framework is completed; nothing on AI harms.
Nothing on AI used in administration.
No AI model, dataset or computing named.
Training named is on freedom of information for community groups, journalists and citizens, not civil servants' digital skills.
No digital-skills programme for the public stated.
Only a press-freedom ranking and an unspecific decline in violations; no dated criticism, punishment, cut or repeal.
